training: All complete nonoverlapping 64-decision tiles, restarts at stage boundaries with a preceding human command. Single shuffled pass per epoch. Original four-title vocabulary uses its reserved unknown ID for TH08 and each of its four new teams. No validation-based selection.
scoring: Score frozen, one-pass and four-pass models once on the same separately assigned TH08 players. Report per-person direction, actual changes, joint four-head token accuracy and joint NLL. Primary comparison is four passes minus frozen, macro-averaged across authors. Only earlier genuine human keys and metadata are available. Original images are absent.
